Or so one would think, but her undefended and erotic body and unconscious physical contact make something like training seem impossible...!? Can he really get stronger like this?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hokuto no Ken: Fist of the North Star Part 2
title_japanese: 北斗の拳 -FIST OF THE NORTH STAR- 第2クール
synopsis: Second part of Hokuto no Ken: Fist of the North Star.

title: The Boxer
synopsis:
Having suffered ruthless bullying for the better part of his life, 17-year-old Yu has become emotionally numb and dissociated from reality, no longer able to act like a normal human being. Although he possesses the exceptional talent to dodge punches, Yu prefers to let his perpetrators beat him down as he finds no meaning in his survival.

Things begin to look up when Yu meets an old boxing trainer nicknamed "K." Having raised five champions, K's years of experience and an impressive gut feeling allow him to recognize Yu's near-superhuman fighting charisma immediately. K rushes to take Yu under his wing, despite the latter's apparent lack of interest.

However, after being reminded of a bright memory from the past, Yu has a change of heart and accepts K's offer, hoping to experience the same light once again. Thus, Yu enters a world full of formidable adversaries—righteous and monstrous alike—and for the first time ever, he has no choice but to fight back.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Starlight Project (Shinsaku Animation Zoku-hen)
title_japanese: スタァライト プロジェクト 新作アニメーション
synopsis: A new anime sequel for the Starlight Project series.

title: Special Kid Factory
title_japanese: スペシャルキッド・ファクトリー
synopsis:
The suspense sci-fi anime takes place in a future where unbeknownst to the people of Earth, there wages an interstellar war spanning the entire universe. Alien arms dealers control our world from behind the scenes, using it as a supersoldier factory where "special kids" with unique abilities are abducted to fight in wars on the other side of the universe. When one "special kid" escapes captivity and journeys back to earth, a seemingly ordinary boy discovers he is a body double for the family all while being drawn unarmed into the heart of a space war.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Zeikin de Katta Hon
synopsis:
Ishidaira is a delinquent who visited the library for the first time since elementary school. He discovered that he still hadn't returned a book he borrowed 10 years ago. He ended up having to work part-time at the library to pay for it. This is the beginning of a manga that makes you want to go to the library after you read it.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Ryuugeshou no Shinobi
synopsis:
Tokyo, 2029. Long believed to have vanished after the asteroid impact that caused their extinction, dinosaurs secretly survived by passing their DNA into humanity through interbreeding. Hidden among ordinary people, they now prey upon humans while living unnoticed within society.

Standing against them is a covert order of ninjas who wield Ryugesho, a special pigment infused with ancient memories. By applying this mysterious pigment, they awaken the powers of dinosaurs within themselves and fight back against the predators threatening humanity.

As the dinosaurs launch their campaign to wipe out humankind, the ninjas rise to stop them. The battle for the survival of two species begins.

(Source: Official website)

title: Hone Dragon no Mana Musume
synopsis:
In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out.

After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks...

Hoping to improve Eve's control over her magical abilities before his resurrected body gives out, the skull dragon sets out on an adventure with his reckless human daughter—but who knows what kind of trouble awaits them?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Tianbao Fuyao Lu 3rd Season
title_japanese: 天宝伏妖录 第三季
synopsis: Third season of Tianbao Fuyao Lu.

title: MARRIAGETOXIN 2nd Season
title_japanese: マリッジトキシン 第2期
synopsis: The second season of MARRIAGETOXIN.

title: Umi ga Hashiru End Roll
title_japanese: 海が走るエンドロール
synopsis:
Umiko Chino, a 65-year-old widow, has no noteworthy hobbies to speak of. When her VCR stops working, Umiko decides to pay a visit to the cinema, like she once did with her husband on their first date. However, instead of focusing on the movie, her gaze is fixed upon the audience—and on one young-looking person in particular.

After the credits roll, the mysterious person introduces themself to Umiko as Kai Hamauchi—a male college student majoring in film. Umiko asks him to fix her VCR, and Kai obliges. Yet, before Kai leaves, he asks Umiko a question that changes the course of her life: would she like to make a movie with him?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Watashi wo Center ni Suru to Chikaimasu ka?
title_japanese: 私をセンターにすると誓いますか？
synopsis:
"If you can really make me the Center...then we can get married."

Meet Mizuki Natsuno, the least popular member of the nationally acclaimed idol group, Melty Strawberry. She has an eternal fan in Koichi Okuta, who is always pouring heart and soul into supporting her. Normally, a fan would never get to interact with their idol beyond the stage. But one thing led to another, and Koichi now finds himself living together with Mizuki in his own house. He vows to make her the new Center of Melty Strawberry, sparking an unconventional tag-team between a devoted fan and his idol. Together, they attempt to elevate Mizuki's career from obscurity to stardom!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Around 40 Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki
title_japanese: アラフォー賢者の異世界生活日記
synopsis:
Forty-year-old Satoshi Osako is a farmer in the Japanese countryside—and a hardcore player of Swords & Sorceries, an online VRRPG. The day he finally manages to defeat the game's final boss, it curses him with its dying breath and kills him in real life! With a little help from a carefree goddess, Satoshi finds himself reincarnated into a mysterious new world as his in-game character, the incredibly powerful Great Sage known as Zelos Merlin. He accordingly decides to use his newfound powers to...continue living a quiet life on another farm! But first, he'll have to fight his way out of the vast, dangerous forest he woke up in—thanks a lot, goddess—and it won't be long before he's running into bandits, getting roped into teaching a young noble girl magic, and more. Will the almighty Great Sage be able to conquer the toughest quest of all: getting some peace and quiet?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ruri Dragon
synopsis:
Well, a half dragon. Her mom admits Ruri inherited her draconic traits from her father, who, yes, is actually a dragon. As if dealing with curious classmates wasn’t already challenging enough, Ruri and her dragon genes literally turn up the heat in the middle of a lecture. Her ordinary life is about to be anything but!

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu 3rd Season
title_japanese: 僕の心のヤバイやつ 第3期
synopsis: The third season of Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu.

title: Wataridori to Katatsumuri
synopsis:
Unpei Mochizuki, a second-year employee at a machine part wholesaler, makes a mistake that causes problems for his clients. Feeling upset, he thinks about running away to a place where no one knows him. That's when he meets Tsugumi Nagisa, a picture book author with a youthful face and glasses, who travels around with her dog in her car, which they use as their home. They spend their days on the road, living in the car and enjoying a new way of traveling, free from any schedule.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Game Sekai Tensei "Dankatsu": Gamer wa "Dungeon Shuukatsu no Susume" wo "Hajime kara" Play suru
title_japanese: ゲーム世界転生〈ダン活〉～ゲーマーは【ダンジョン就活のススメ】を〈はじめから〉プレイする
synopsis:
After finding himself reincarnated as the protagonist of the god-tier game "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", Zephyrus is far from intimidated. Instead, he's absolutely thrilled! As a seasoned gamer who knows every nook and cranny of this world, he now has the chance to live within a massive system featuring an unprecedented 1,021 playable classes and over 400 different endings.

Armed with an encyclopedic knowledge of the game's mechanics, Zephyrus wastes no time enrolling in the Labyrinth Academy, the central stage where the real adventure begins. He has his sights set on a single goal: securing the fabled "Hero" class. Alongside his childhood friend, whom he guides toward the Alchemist path, Zephyrus is ready to sweep up rare loot and power-level at a breakneck pace!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Hokuhokusei ni Kumo to Ike
synopsis:
Seventeen-year-old Kei Miyama comes from a family with strange abilities. Birds flock to his grandfather as if he is the wind that carries them in the air itself. Kei, on the other hand, can talk to cars and prefers their company to humans—especially women. After moving to Iceland, Kei makes a living there as a freelance detective.

Whether it be resolving lovers' quarrels, locating missing people, or recovering lost items, Kei hops from case to case, traveling alone on the empty roads that span the rugged Icelandic landscape. But the secrets of the land of ice and fire are not the only mysteries ahead that Kei must unravel: an encounter with an aloof Icelandic beauty makes him recall local superstitions of ghosts that roam the wild lands at night.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Ousama no Propose
synopsis:
With looks to die for, Saika Kuozaki is the most powerful mage in existence and the only one who can thwart the annihilation factors that attempt to destroy the world once every three hundred hours. When Saika is mortally wounded, however, she bequeaths both her powers and body to the normal high school boy who happens to find her, Mushiki Kuga. Just because Mushiki inherits her abilities, though, doesn't mean he can control them. To stand a chance of saving the world, Mushiki will have to attend an academy for mages as Saika—while trying to keep his true identity under wraps!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Kaijuu 8-gou: Kanketsu-hen
synopsis: Sequel to Kaijuu 8-gou 2nd Season.

title: Gigant
synopsis:
Rei Yokoyamada, a high schooler whose father works for a film production company, is inspired to create his own short film with his friends. One day, while out to find actors, he spots tabloid-like notices that the adult film star Papico lives in his area. When he takes them down to protect her, he runs into the woman herself. Little does he know that Papico is about to get dragged into a strange, supernatural happening...where she grows to the size of a giant!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: 7-nin no Nemurihime
synopsis:
In the enchanting Kingdom of Amaryllis, a wandering prince embarks on a noble quest to break an ancient curse that bewitched the land. His mission: to awaken the princess with a true love's kiss. There's just one tiny detail no one warned him about—there are seven princesses to kiss! Undeterred, he takes up the challenge and finds himself living amongst them to unravel the mystery behind the kingdom's slumbering state. Will they all eventually find their happily ever after?

(Source: MU)

title: 8-gatsu 31-nichi no Long Summer
synopsis:
Two high schoolers, Suzuki-kun and Takagi-san, met in a time loop on August 31st. They are the only ones who can retain their memories when the day repeats itself. A possible cause of the time loop is Suzuki-kun's unfinished business for the summer, a guy's greatest objective... A time loop comedy of youth that tackles love head-on!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Sailor Zombie
synopsis:
Two months have passed since a zombie epidemic began. Despite the chaos around, three high school students in sailor suits live ordinary school lives.

Maiko is a transfer student. She hopes to become an idol. Even though Maiko goes through various incidents, her friendship with Momoka and Mutsumi deepens.

One day, zombies attack people. Music comes out from the radio and the zombies stop their attack to dance. With this type of music, humans are protected from the zombies, but they can't find the music source. Since then, Maiko, Momoka and Mutsumi are threatened by the zombies.

(Source: Asian Wiki)

title: Kamisama Gakkou no Ochikobore
title_japanese: 神さま学校の落ちこぼれ
synopsis:
Modern life means modern solutions—even to supernatural problems. So of course the government would have a classification system, special schools, and licenses for people with mysterious powers. Any manifestation of a miracle is enough to be called a Himiko, but only those with full certification may use the title of god. And high schooler Nagi is in serious need of a god! The death of her grandmother has left her family shrine devoid of the necessary divinity, and her hopelessly shut-in Himiko brother isn't looking promising. But if Nagi isn't careful, her search for a god might end with her finding more than she bargained for...

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Milky☆Byway Spring Special: Kyoufu no Chelovin Party
title_english: Milky☆Byway Spring Special: Terror on Chelovin's Day
title_japanese: ミルキー☆バイウェイ スプリングスペシャル “恐怖のチェロビン・パーティー”

title: Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko
title_english: The Strongest Man, Born from Misfortune
synopsis:
"Fortune and Misfortune are two sides of the same coin?! Reverse any adversary and cease redemption!!" Siegbert is reborn after an unfortunate accident in his previous life. His new family is warm and welcoming... so much so it seems as though he may no longer be an unlucky person. In this world, he can finally live a quiet, peaceful life... or so he thought. It seems that he actually holds an insanely high luck stat in this new world...? "Every chance is a manifestation of good fortune. If you can cease the chances, your wishes shall be granted..." Conquering each "chance" granted by his good fortune, will he now cease redemption on the generational legacy this family has yet to fulfill?!

(Source: Starts Shuppan)

title: Nan Hong
synopsis:
When Wen Yifan returned to her hometown for work, she unexpectedly ran into the rumored "First-Class Handsome Guy" at a bar. However, she soon discovered that he was Sang Yan, someone she had hurt and rejected in high school. In a twist of fate, these two individuals who could never get along found themselves constantly crossing paths. They even ended up renting the same unit by chance and becoming housemates. With unspoken feelings buried deep within, strong emotions begin to stir...

Let's see how Sang Yan, the "Peak Ideal Boyfriend," interprets and expresses his profound affection and sweet love!

(Source: INKR)

title: J⇔Ｍ
synopsis:
J is a legendary hitman who is feared in the underworld as "untouchable." One day, while walking on the street, he accidentally collides into a lonely elementary school girl named Megumi. However, because of the accident, they switch bodies.

J is now forced to go through the life of the schoolgirl Megumi, while Megumi is now forced to go through the life of the hitman J. One chaotic and comical situation after another ensues as they go through each other's life.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Houkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru
title_japanese: 放課後のアイドルには秘密がある
synopsis:
Hiruno Hizashi, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka VI
title_japanese: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうかⅤI
synopsis: The sixth season of Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka.

title: Free Fire Daybreak
synopsis:
In the near-future city of New Dawn, ruled by the powerful Horizon Corporation, 16-year-old Kelly becomes entangled in the experimental "Project Bloom" and awakens "Limit Break", an extraordinary ability capable of unlocking anything that has been sealed away.

As fragments of her past begin to resurface, Kelly joins newfound allies to uncover the conspiracy surrounding Horizon Corporation and confront the forces threatening the future of New Dawn.

What fate lies ahead?

(Source: Garena)

title: Yuukyuu no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume
title_english: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom
title_japanese: 悠久の愚者アズリーの、賢者のすゝめ
synopsis:
When Asley was young, he had dropped from the Magic Academy and was looked down by others. However by chance, he discovered a god medicine and obtained an immortal body. In order to take revenge on the people who made fun of him, he started to work on the research of magic and magical artifacts much different from those developed in the academy, and before he even noticed, 5000 years have passed and he became an ancient magic user.

Losing his purpose life, Asley goes out on a journey with his familiar, Pochi, to see the world after 5000 years. With an unexpected turns of events after helping many humans, he is now living at the Magic Academy...

How a 5000-year-old with young appearance Asley will live his second life?

(Source: Official site)

title: Hina
synopsis:
The "highly entertaining action drama" is set in Izu, Japan, where men are fighting over a woman called Hina. What is it exactly that makes Hina mislead men? As the men try to reveal their true feelings for Hina, strong, muscly men also get involved and the sound of the festival drum signals the start of a confrontation. 

(Source: Variety, edited)

title: Kin to Tetsu
synopsis:
Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Douwa Revenger: Petit
title_japanese: 童話リベンジャーズ ぷち
synopsis: Sequel for Douwa Revenger.

title: Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihou saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu
title_japanese: 真の聖女である私は追放されました。だからこの国はもう終わりです
synopsis:
"You are not the real saint; you're nothing but a fake!"

I, Eliane, am suddenly exiled. Not only that, my engagement was also annulled by Claude, who was both my fiancé and the first prince of my country. Claude claims that Leticia is the "real saint," but I know from the beginning, she is the woman he has been cheating on me with. So here I am, sharing his wish to cancel our engagement.

But is exiling me truly a wise decision, I wonder? Exiling this me, the actual "real saint" who has been setting up barriers and supporting this kingdom from shadows? Maybe, just maybe, dragons and archdemons will invade my kingdom starting from tomorrow. Who knows—not like it's any of my business anymore. I have abandoned my own country and have thus decided to have a peaceful life. Meanwhile, the kingdom, which has lost its true saint, is on the path to ruin.

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)

title: Real mo Tama ni wa Uso wo Tsuku
title_japanese: 現実もたまには嘘をつく
synopsis:
Nanami and uses a male avatar. Kaoru has been lying about his identity, and the two will soon meet in real life for the first time. When the day finally arrives, they realize that their expectations are quite different from reality.

Contrary to Kaoru's expectations, Nanami turns out to be a girl. With their genders revealed, they are both in shock—especially Nanami. She has already told her enthusiastic mother and overprotective father about her female friend coming to their house. Consequently, Nanami comes up with an idea to mask Kaoru's true gender: crossdressing! Even though their friendship started with lies, this odd meetup marks the beginning of their unusual bond.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Paradox Live the Animation Movie
title_japanese: Paradox Live THE ANIMATION 映画
synopsis: Movie adaptation of Paradox Live the Animation. Will feature a total of 29 characters from 9 teams, including characters who have appeared in the TV series so far, as well as new characters.

title: Suisou no Tora
synopsis:
Something/someone is there. This fact seeks a cornerstone of the reality of a personal experience. For this reason each individual's reality has a disparity that seems like it has been pre-programmed.

(Source: Shinomiya Yoshitoshi's personal website)

A tiger is jumping around in a dark basin of water, seemingly trying to catch a bird, of which there are many.

title: Uchuu Senkan Yamato √2199
synopsis: New movie for Uchuu Senkan Yamato.

title: Kimetsu no Yaiba: Mugenjou-hen Movie 3
title_japanese: 劇場版「鬼滅の刃」無限城編 第終章
synopsis: Part 3 of the theatrical trilogy adaptation of the Infinity Castle Arc.

title: Cubistar
synopsis:
Davi and her new friends become Cubistars. Magical guardians bestowed with powers of the stars to maintain the balance between good and evil.

(Source: iABC)

title: Mii-chan to Yamada-san
title_japanese: みいちゃんと山田さん
synopsis:
In the heart of Shinjuku, there are a variety of host and hostess nightclubs open to customers seeking a night of indulgence with a gorgeous companion. Yamada is one of those companions. She balances university and work, but finds herself more interested in becoming a model hostess than a star pupil. The pay is too tempting to resist, which is why so many girls come and go in the industry. But in 2012, she meets someone completely different. Mii-chan is a petite young woman who seems to be rather useless at most things—barely able to read or write and, unfortunately, clumsy—earning her ridicule from staff and customers alike. However, her bright energy and endless motivation proves hard to ignore, and Yamada finds herself drawn in by Mii-chan's charm.

A beautiful and tragic story about an unlikely friendship and the unfortunate end that separated them forever.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Akazukin, Tabi no Tochuu de Shitai to Deau.
title_english: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story
title_japanese: 赤ずきん、旅の途中で死体と出会う。
synopsis:
The fairytale of Little Red Riding Hood is as classic as they come, a familiar delivery of cookies and wine. But on this particular journey, Little Red Riding Hood... encounters a dead body?! As the mystery begins to unfold, familiar faces from other fairytales such as "Cinderella," "Hansel and Gretel," and "Sleeping Beauty" bring their own countless twists and tricks. Will she be able to solve the larger puzzle at the center of it all? A new detective is born!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Boku no Suki na Hito ga Suki na Hito
title_japanese: ぼくの好きな人が好きな人
synopsis:
Sora Akizuki, a second-year high school student, gets rejected by his junior and crush, Miya Fuwa, because she is in love with Asahi Suzukaze—the president of the "Clinical Trials Club." To learn more, Sora decides to join the mysterious club. There, he is shocked to discover that Asahi actually has a crush on the "Clinical Trials Prince," a boy who saved her through a clinical trial program when she was sick as a child. Unbeknownst to anyone, the childhood prince Asahi is looking for is actually Sora himself back in elementary school.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete 2nd Season
title_japanese: 魔法少女にあこがれて 第2期
synopsis: The second season of Mahou Shoujo ni Akogarete.

title: Toratsugumi: Tsugumi Project
synopsis:
In the distant future, the region once known as Japan has transformed into a deadly wasteland teeming with high radiation and bizarre monsters. This forbidden zone has long been uninhabitable for humans.

The story centers on Leon, a man framed for a crime he didn't commit, torn away from his wife and child, and sent to death row. To survive, he is forced to take on a highly classified, perilous mission with only two outcomes: success or death.

In the heart of this lethal territory, Leon encounters a variety of strange creatures—from a mysterious young girl to colossal beasts—that will forever change his fate.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Odekake Hololive
synopsis:
"Where shall we go today?"

The unique girls of the VTuber agency "Hololive Production" are usually seen behind screens during their livestreams. However, on their days off, it seems they head out to explore various places?

Traveling across Japan through all four seasons, eating delicious food, laughing together, and visiting places they have yet to discover! An omnibus travel story depicting their exceptionally lively and fun outings!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Huhuan Shaonu
synopsis:
Ye Xi was an ordinary girl, nothing special. She wasn't the worst at anything, but she was never the best either. She was as invisible as air, utterly unremarkable. Until she met Li Zhao…

Li Zhao had her own goals; she wanted to become a top fashion designer. From a young age, every step she took was a step closer to her dream.

This is the story of a group of girls who met through fashion and are pursuing their dreams, occasionally interspersed with some lighthearted and silly everyday moments!

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

title: Juuheisou-gata Joshikousei
synopsis:
As a mysterious girl gazes into the distant sky and a high school girl named Ichi stands still, the story follows what they will see within this devastated world and what kind of tale they will weave.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Charisma
synopsis:
"They're just ordinary guys."

Arranged by the mysterious Fumiya Itou, a seven-person sharehouse has become home to a group of charismatic guys, taking on the name "Charisma House." From the "dog for the people" Iori Motohashi to rebellious "just say no!" Kei Sarukawa, each member has their own unique charisma that they nurture day by day. Whether it's Amahiko Tendou fulfilling his role as World Sexy Ambassador, or Terra falling in love with his own reflection, or Ohse Minato attempting to jump out of another window, the Charisma House is always lively, even if it challenges Rikai Kusanagi's attempts to maintain rigid order. Ordinary people just wouldn't understand.

Despite what people might say about their unique habits, other's opinions can't faze the Charismas, who simply turn adversities into fuel to power their "Charisma Charge." But what might happen when this charge fills up..?!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Kyoukai no Melody
synopsis:
After losing his musical partner Kai in an accident just before their major debut, Kyousuke has distanced himself from music and lives without motivation. Three years later, Kai suddenly appears before Kyousuke, unchanged and as outspoken as ever.

"Being alive but doing nothing... that's no different from being dead."

Encouraged by Kai's words, Kyousuke returns to the world of music, rediscovering the joy of creating sound together. But their time together cannot last forever...

(Source: MAL News)

title: Danzai sareta Akuyaku Reijou wa, Gyakkou shite Kanpeki na Akujo wo Mezasu
title_japanese: 断罪された悪役令嬢は、逆行して完璧な悪女を目指す
synopsis:
Claudia, daughter of a duke, is tricked by her wicked half-sister and sold off to a brothel. Unwilling to accept defeat, Claudia uses the tools at her disposal and becomes one of the most successful sex workers in her new home. That's when she dies—only to be thrust back in time to age fourteen! Gone is the gullible girl of her academy days now that she's got street savvy and hard-won seductive skills. It's Claudia's turn to play the evil villainess, and there's nothing she won't do to protect what's hers!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Decapolice
synopsis:
DECASIM, a virtual world created from a perfect copy of reality. More than just a simulation, it's a complete copy of a real city, a forbidden place where memories of every past crime lie dormant. "Clues" found in DECASIM can help unravel the riddles of the real world.

(Source: Official site)

title: Kimi wa Yotsuba no Clover
title_japanese: きみは四葉のクローバー
synopsis:
The romantic suspense manga centers around Uichi, a once popular student who is now relentlessly bullied in high school. Still, he strives everyday to keep a promise to Yotsuha (his first love from elementary school before she transferred schools) to become a veterinarian. Just as he reaches his limit with the bullying, Yotsuha suddenly appears before him. She has seemingly not changed since back then — except she harbors only one hidden resolve deep in her eyes.

(Source: ANN)

title: Saijaku na Boku wa "Kabenuke Bug" de Nariagaru
title_japanese: 最弱な僕は〈壁抜けバグ〉で成り上がる
synopsis:
The series follows Henri Cleats, an adventurer who only has a single skill: Evasion. Wanting to take care of his sickly younger sister Colette, he joins a party. However, due to weak attack power and lack of skills, he is expelled from this party. However, it turns out that his evasion skill comes with a bonus: he is able to pass through walls and reach the end of dungeons without defeating the boss. Thus, he is able to claim a dungeon's First Clear bonus more than once. With his newfound knowledge, Henri sets out to clear as many dungeons as he can while also leveling up his power.

(Source: Wikipedia)

title: Phantom Busters
title_japanese: ファントムバスターズ
synopsis:
In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Koutarou Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro's got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters?

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Re:bel Robotica
synopsis:
Robotica. Machines made in the very likeness of humankind.
Robotica. Beings that exist to serve humanity.
Robotica. Created to bring people happiness.

The year 2050—In a near-future Tokyo where dramatic leaps in information technology have promised every person a comfortable, contented life: Shibuya. An enigmatic girl named Lily. Her very existence will shake the world.

(Source: Press Release)

title: Quanzhi Fashi Tebie Pian: Beiyuan Weiji
title_english: The Almighty Mage SP: Beiyuan Crisis
title_japanese: 全职法师特别篇之北原危机
synopsis:
Mo Fan, Lingling, Zhao Manyan, and others come to Beiyuan to investigate the mysterious destruction of Beiyuan Village. During their investigation, they discover that it was the work of Leng Jue of the Black Church, who was parasitized by the Red Beast, who colluded with the evil forces of Nile. They also discover that there is an even bigger conspiracy behind them. When faced with the Red Beast's trap again, what actions will Mo Fan and his companions take?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: AKIRA (Shin Anime)
synopsis: Announced at Anime Expo 2019, the project is meant to be a complete adaptation of Ootomo Katsuhiro's post-apocalyptic cyberpunk manga AKIRA.

title: S-Rank Boukensha de Aru Ore no Musume-tachi wa Juudo no Fathercon deshita
title_japanese: Sランク冒険者である俺の娘たちは重度のファザコンでした
synopsis:
During a quest to subdue wyverns, A-rank adventurer Kaiser Clyde witnesses an ancient dragon awaken from its slumber, fly to a nearby village, and immediately destroy it. In the aftermath, Kaiser frantically searches for survivors and finds three babies among the rubble. Feeling responsible for the deaths of the village's populace, Kaiser decides to retire and take care of the children as his daughters.

Bestowing upon them the names Elsa, Anna, and Meryl, Kaiser raises the girls with as much love and affection as he can give. As the years pass, each of his daughters' talents begins to rapidly develop in swordsmanship, management, and magic, respectively. However, despite their unique dispositions, Elsa, Anna, and Meryl all have one thing in common: their overflowing love for their father that seemingly exceeds simple familial bonds.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: One Punch Man 3 Part 2
title_japanese: ワンパンマン 第3期第2クール
synopsis: The second cour of the third season of One Punch Man.

title: Ultraman: Darkness Heels
title_japanese: DARKNESS HEELS（ダークネスヒールズ）
synopsis: Anime adaptation for the Ultraman franchise's Darkness Heels project.

title: Mamonotsukai no Musume
synopsis:
Veteran adventurer Hakura has overcome countless trials, but his latest fight with a deadly hydra nearly costs him his life. In the nick of time, he is saved by an intriguing young lady named Leen, who, to his surprise, possesses the rare ability to tame any and all monsters! Now indebted to this unscrupulous monstermancer, Hakura decides to join her in her travels, the two of them arguing and bickering every step of the way. What has drawn them together, and what adventures await this unlikely pair?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Koishita Hito wa, Imouto no Kawari ni Shindekure to Itta. Imouto to Kekkon shita Kataomoi Aite ga Naze Imasara Watashi no Moto ni? To Omottara
title_japanese: 恋した人は、妹の代わりに死んでくれと言った。―妹と結婚した片思い相手がなぜ今さら私のもとに?と思ったら―
synopsis:
Lady Wisteria's greatest wish is to be worthy of the man she loves, Lord Bright. But when Wisteria's little sister, Rosalie, is selected to enter the Predawn Realm as its guardian, never to return, Bright begs Wisteria to take Rosalie's place! After all, Wisteria is skilled with magic, and resistant to the sinister miasma that threatens the mortal world. Heartbroken, Wisteria enters the Predawn Realm, accompanied by the sacred sword, Sartis. More than twenty years later, a stranger with a familiar face appears, demanding the sword and challenging Wisteria. Who is he, and why does he resemble Lord Bright...?

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: Shuiro no Kamen Part 2
synopsis: Part two of Shuiro no Kamen.

title: NARUTO (2026)
synopsis:
The official website for the NARUTO anime franchise announced a new anime project: to air four "brand-new" episodes to celebrate the TV anime's 20th anniversary back in 2022. (Source: Anime News Network, edited) 
Note: Title, format, and relations are provisional and will be updated when more info is announced.

title: Death Stranding: Isolation
synopsis:
Once, there was an explosion...

Lonesome souls of the dead manifest in the physical world, reaching in search of the living. However, the connection they create triggers a massive explosion that eradicates anything of this world—a phenomenon referred to as the Death Stranding. These events wipe out nations as well as civilization itself. People who remain are now isolated, withdrawn, and without connections. As humanity stands at the brink, a legendary porter sets out to transport both cargo and wishes of its senders, reconnecting people in the hope that they might still be saved.

Somewhere in North America, just as Sam Bridges walks through the continent in order to save America, the others are also trying to deal with their isolation in their own way. An old man trying to realize salvation through ways outside of the connection advocated by Bridges. A female warrior who tries to kickstart a world of constant fighting. A boy with a grudge against Bridges. A girl who embraces loneliness.

On the precipice of the end of humanity and the world, their fates and hopes converge, as another story of Death Stranding begins.

And now, comes another explosion... 

(Source: Kojima Productions, edited)

title: Ginga Tetsudou 999 (New Movie)
title_japanese: 劇場用長編アニメーション 銀河鉄道999
synopsis: New theatrical adaptation of Ginga Tetsudou 999.

title: Bad End Mokuzen no Heroine ni Tensei shita Watashi, Konse dewa Renai suru Tsumori ga Cheat na Ani ga Hanashite Kuremasen!?
title_japanese: バッドエンド目前のヒロインに転生した私、今世では恋愛するつもりがチートな兄が離してくれません!?
synopsis:
A dating sim enthusiast wakes up in the body of Reine Waynewright: an adorable otome heroine in a fantasy game! Reine discovers that in this world, she's a lowly F-rank student at the magical Heartfelt Academy, bullied by her classmates and snubbed by her love interests for her lack of talent. Determined to avoid a Bad Ending, Reine resolves to study hard, practice her magic, and pass the exams to increase her rank!

If she grinds hard enough, she may be able to change her fate: make new friends, improve herself, and maybe even fall in love along the way!

(Source: Tokyopop)

title: E, Shanai System Subete One Operation shiteiru Watashi wo Kaiko desu ka?
title_japanese: え、社内システム全てワンオペしている私を解雇ですか？
synopsis:
Ai Satou is the sole engineer maintaining her company's internal systems. It's too bad being the linchpin who keeps it all running won't protect her from sudden layoffs. Apparently, the new CEO doesn't approve of cosplaying at work.

Depressed and jobless, Ai unexpectedly reunites with her childhood friend, Kenta Suzuki, who makes her an offer. His startup, True Coding School, provides personalized lessons to people struggling under the stress of modern society, and he wants her to join his team.

With every passionate—and sometimes unconventional—lecture, Ai finds herself giving her students a renewed sense of purpose. Who knew that coding lessons could change so many lives?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Qiu Mo
synopsis:
The story tells of how the protagonist, Su Ming, suffers a sudden upheaval in his hometown and embarks on a journey of cultivation, seeking enlightenment and love on a strange continent, fighting against fate in order to find his way home.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Destiny Unchain Online
synopsis:
Kou Mitsuki is a gamer with god-tier skills, known online as Crim the Headhunter. Right when he starts testing his father's latest game, Destiny Unchain Online, and the new device developed for it, the bug-ridden system transforms him in into a vampire girl! Everything changes for Kou as he meets new friends and they take on the game... The ultimate gamer adventure awaits!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Everyday Host (Zoku-hen)
title_japanese: えぶりでいホスト 続編
synopsis: Sequel to Everyday Host.

title: Idomo
synopsis:
The story starts in a mysterious place in the future where "boys and girls meet."

(Source: ANN)

title: Tsuihou sareta Shounin wa Kane no Chikara de Sekai wo Sukuu
title_japanese: 追放された商人は金の力で世界を救う
synopsis:
Torao is a merchant in the S-rank adventurer party, Blue Ring. He is kicked out of the group after being caught secretly providing financial support to Garnet, a rookie all-female adventurer party.

Following his exile, Torao leaves them with a stern warning, but Blue Ring ignores it and recklessly challenges the Demon King, leading to their total annihilation. Torao subsequently joins Garnet. Ironically, their very first mission is to head to the front lines to salvage valuable equipment from the corpses of the wiped-out Blue Ring members.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Maebashi Witches: Majo Minarai no Emoemories
title_japanese: 前橋ウィッチーズ ～魔女見習いのエモエモリーズ～
synopsis: Theatrical compilation of Maebashi Witches.

title: Ye de Mingming Shu
synopsis:
Qingchen's parents divorced when he was young. In order not to cause trouble to his mother, he voluntarily lived with his gambling-addicted father. One day, with the appearance of a mysterious countdown on his arm, Qingchen's life changed. It connected two completely different worlds, and the moment the countdown reached zero, time stopped and space shattered. Qingchen traveled through time and space to the dangerous Prison No. 18 in the other world. Under the dense steel sky, he relied on courage and wisdom to forge ahead, overcame many tests, and was appreciated by the demigod Li Shutong. In the end, Qingchen was able to worship Li Shutong as his master, and Li Shutong will take Qingchen on the longest road among all the shortcuts in this world.

(Source: Bilibili, Google translated)

title: Sunny
synopsis:
To be released in 2029.

What is Sunny? Sunny is a car. Sunny is a car you take on a drive with your mind. It takes you to the place of your dreams. Sunny is the story of beating the odds, in the ways that count. 

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: Mahou no Princess Minky Momo: Akogare no Yume e - Magokoro no Duo
title_japanese: 魔法のプリンセス ミンキーモモ 憧れの夢へ まごころの二重奏
synopsis: A new original video anime for Mahou no Princess Minky Momo.

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Divinez Unmei Seisen-hen
title_japanese: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード DivineZ 運命星戦編
synopsis: Final Arc of Cardfight!! Vanguard: D Series.

title: Monster Strike: Mera×Death - Shinigami to Boku no Ijou na Koi
title_japanese: モンスターストライク メラ×デス 死神と僕の異常な恋
synopsis:
Six years ago, a massive explosion occurred in the town of Ouma, but miraculously, there were no fatalities.

In this city where a mysterious sphere called "Glass Sun" floats in the sky, a boy named Mera Kagari, who feels out of place and lives a boring life, meets a mysterious girl named Thirteen on his 16th birthday.

Her encounter with her brings vibrant colors to Mera's previously monochrome life, but at the same time, strange occurrences begin to unfold in the city.

(Source: MAL news)

title: Blue Lock: NEO EGOIST LEAGUE
title_japanese: ブルーロック ネオ・エゴイストリーグ
synopsis: The third season of Blue Lock.

title: Shin Kochira Katsushikaku Kameari Kouenmae Hashutsujo
title_japanese: 新こちら葛飾区亀有公園前派出所
synopsis: Ryoutsu, being an underpaid policeman, is always coming up with underhanded schemes in order to make a quick buck. But in the end, his plans (which are ridiculous to begin with) always go wrong and land him in big trouble with the chief.

title: Mahoutsukai Rosé no Sado Life
title_japanese: 魔法使いロゼの佐渡ライフ
synopsis:
The story begins when Rosé is transported from another world to Japan. Right after arriving, she is attacked by a bird, but she's saved by a local resident named Sana Tsuchiya.

Since Rosé has just arrived and lacks both money and any sense of her surroundings, she ends up moving in with Sana. At first, after watching TV at Sana's house, Rosé assumes she has been transported to Tokyo—but in reality, she is on Sado Island.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Zuoshou Shanglan 3
synopsis:
Xu Xingze ended up at Jingbei Affiliated High School by chance, where he met a group of supportive and comrades-in-arms on the basketball team. Through a series of intense games, he gradually discovered the meaning of playing basketball and strengthened his resolve. He longed to defeat Cheng Feng's Beihai Middle School to prove himself, but before that, they have to overcome the formidable obstacle of Jingshi Affiliated High School…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Vampire Juujikai
title_english: The Record of a Fallen Vampire
synopsis:
There is a legend that tells of how the world was almost destroyed thousands of years ago by the vampire queen after she unleashed her latent powers. Despite their efforts, the humans were unable to defeat her, and thus resorted to sealing her away until the time came that they would be powerful enough to destroy the seal and kill her. However, the humans are not the only ones after the seal. Having cast aside his kingdom and betraying his own race and the dhampirs (half-vampires), the vampire king is persistently searching, even to this day, for where his queen has been sealed away so he may break the seal and free her before the humans do. Fearing that once the king and queen are reunited, they shall continue to destroy the world together, the humans and dhampirs hunt the king, using any method possible.

(Source: Anime Source)

title: Douluo Dalu: 9528
synopsis:
Tang San and Xiao Wu return to the Slaughter City, ravaged by the Blood Swan's Kiss. ​​They're hunted down by the mutated Slaughter King. A mysterious girl intervenes to save them, but a hidden agenda lies behind the scenes. Together, they'll uncover the truth behind the Slaughter City.

(Source: Tencent, Google translated)

title: Macross (Shinsaku Animation)
title_japanese: マクロス (新作アニメーション)

title: Ikyou no Tsume Nuri Minarai
synopsis:
Keiko Sahara, an office worker with a hobby in gel nails, is suddenly transported to a world where magic is used through nails. In this world, "Nail Painters" create spells by painting magical materials onto nails. By chance, Keiko becomes a nail painter apprentice and begins a new life in this other world, working alongside eccentric master sorcerer Rocco, his apprentice Hou, and her nail painting mentor Lido. This is a workplace fantasy about her journey as a nail painter in a magical realm.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Wu Dong Qian Kun 7th Season
synopsis: Seventh season of Wu Dong Qian Kun.

title: Zhen Hun Jie 5th Season
synopsis:
The world of Rakshasa Street is engulfed in conflict, with various forces stirring with ambition. The united forces of Cao, Sun, and Liu, are unstoppable, the Hall of Heroes suffers a devastating blow, and the Spirit Realm's rule is on the verge of collapse. Countless heroes are emerging, and a new crisis is about to erupt due to the ambitions of the Kingdom Organization. In the world of Rakshasa Street, no one dares to say "no!" Cao Yanbing's path to becoming king has officially begun!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Hinagiku no Jinsei
synopsis:
Following the emotional journey of a six-year-old girl named Daisy, who loses her mother in a tragic accident and struggles to adapt to life with her aunt. One sleepless night, she encounters a mysterious girl named Dahlia at her window. Their days together begin to transcend time and space, bringing a cosmic perspective to Daisy’s modest life in a downtown yakisoba restaurant.

(Source: Variety)

title: Kinnikuman: Kanpeki Choujin Shiso-hen Season 3
title_japanese: キン肉マン 完璧超人始祖編 Season3
synopsis: Third season of Kinnikuman: Kanpeki Chоujin Shiso-hen.

title: Gifted
synopsis:
Natsuki Amakusa is a talented young detective with the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department. One day, he meets Yuuya Shiki, a high school student with a mysterious ability to see "marks" on murderers.

After Yuuya helps solve a complex murder case, Natsuki decides to recruit him. The two team up as partners to investigate various criminal cases while working to uncover the mystery behind Yuuya's hidden power.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Soshiki no Shukuteki to Kekkon shitara Mecha Amai
title_english: It's so Sweet when I Marry my Organization's Nemesis
title_japanese: 組織の宿敵と結婚したらめちゃ甘い
synopsis:
"...I hate you!"
"What a coincidence. So do I."

The two once belonged to opposing organizations of supernatural power users, and fought for their own opposing goals. Roushi Saikawa, also known as the "Feather Hunter," and Ritsuka Yanagi, the strongest supernatural power user known as the "White Demon." The two spent their days battling each other and had no normal social experience, but...

"I love you, Rou-kun."
"Me too, Ritsuka."

After their organization was disbanded, they somehow started dating and then got married! Is their hatred 100 times more adorable? Now, they are the epitome of a lovey-dovey couple, kissing each other at the door every morning when they go to work. But the husband had just one problem. That is, he had never shared a bed with his wife... In other words, even though he was married, he was still a virgin! This is the story of the hardships faced by such a husband, who gets caught up in numerous troubles but continues to make desperate attempts to deepen his love with his strict wife.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Kaijuu Decode: Aidara no Yubiwa
title_japanese: 怪獣デコード アイダラの指輪
synopsis:
Set in Sakai, a youth named Maru lives in the peaceful city, a society freed from the restrictions of the body, mind, space, and time. In contrast, a girl named Coco, a member of the Aidara Tribe, resides in the Zone, a treacherous area also inhabited by incredible beasts. The story revolves around two opposing characters seeking a path into a shared future.

(Source: Sakai Film Office, edited)

title: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT
synopsis:
The time is Sengoku.

Japan is fractured into many independent nations entangled in ceaseless war. At the center lies Ashina, a land of sacred earth and ancient mystery. Two decades after Sword Saint Isshin Ashina reclaimed the region in a brutal coup, a new threat emerges from within: The Interior Ministry. Desperate to protect his homeland, Isshin's grandson Genichiro turns to forbidden powers. The only hope lies in a kidnapped boy — the Divine Heir — and his silent protector: a loyal shinobi known only as Sekiro.

This is the story of a lord and his retainer — and their quest to restore balance to a nation on the edge.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Omae, Tanuki ni Naranee ka?
title_japanese: お前、タヌキにならねーか？
synopsis: A series of encounters with Koganemaru, a magical tanuki that saves the hearts of those in need.

title: Doupo Cangqiong Movie: Shuang Di Zhi Zhan
title_japanese: 斗破苍穹剧场版 双帝之战
synopsis:
Above Canaan Academy, the Soul Clan and the Heavenly Mansion Alliance clashed over the legendary Tuoshe Ancient Emperor. The Soul Emperor used the ancient jade to open his cave, thus beginning the struggle for the opportunity to become an Emperor. With the help of the Void Devouring Flame, the Soul Emperor successfully obtained a preliminary Emperor-grade pill, while Xiao Yan's fate remained unknown during the struggle. The Soul Emperor successfully advanced to Dou Di and led the Soul Clan army to attack the Heavenly Mansion Alliance. Just when everyone was in despair, the Xiao Clan's bloodline stirred. Gu Yuan realized that Xiao Yan might be breaking through to Dou Di, which became everyone's last hope. Everyone fought to the death to buy time for Xiao Yan to become an Emperor, and Xiao Yan lived up to their expectations, descending like a god, and the battle between the two Emperors is about to begin.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title: Saikon Shounin wo Youkyuu Shimasu
title_japanese: 再婚承認を要求します
synopsis:
Empress of the Eastern Nation Navier Ellie Trovi stands at the pinnacle of noblewomen with dignity and grace. Although she and her husband, Emperor Sovieshu, are not as intimate as other couples, their trust in each other has been built over years of friendship. But then, wanting something more, he brings in a concubine—a former slave named Rashta—and that is when everything begins to fall apart.

Months later, the fateful day arrives; Sovieshu declares his intentions to divorce Navier and give her throne to Rashta. However, against all expectations, Navier is not backed against a wall, and she declares her intention to marry another man—Heinrey—whose noble appearance shocks all in the room.

Just who is Heinrey, and how did Navier come to this new marriage arrangement? The Eastern Nation stands at a precipice, being torn apart by conspiracies, lies, and—above all—love.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Odoru Sennen Kazoku
synopsis:
Seven immortal siblings born in England possess humanity's ultimate dream: eternal life. But their gift makes them targets for the criminal underworld, corrupt hospitals, and international military organizations! After centuries apart, this extraordinary family reunites for a thrilling new chapter in their lives.

(Source: Orange Inc.)

title: [Watashi no Ofuru de Waruin dakedo] to Okaasama (Heroine) ni Torimaki wo Oshitsukerare, Totsuida Henkyou demo Yome Atsukai Saremasen ga, Okage de Jiyuu ni Ikiraremasu!
title_japanese: 【私のおふるで悪いんだけど】とお母様(ヒロイン)に取り巻きを押し付けられ、嫁いだ辺境でも嫁扱いされませんが、おかげで自由に生きれます！
synopsis:
After being handed one of her mother's attendants as a fiancé and effectively kicked out of the royal palace, a young noblewoman begins an uneasy new life in her husband's household. The atmosphere is anything but welcoming, though her expressionless husband seems surprisingly kind. With her beloved dolls as companions, she settles into her new home, only to find herself with far too much free time. This is the start of a lighthearted marriage story about unexpected bonds, quiet days, and the dolls who make them a little less lonely.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Aoashi 2nd Season
synopsis:
The second season of Aoashi.Aoi Ashito is now on the elite A team, but he’s quickly overwhelmed by his harsh new reality.
(Source:Crunchyroll)

title: Sasami 14: Mahou Shoujo Pretty Sammy
title_japanese: 砂沙美14 魔法少女プリティサミー
synopsis:
I am Sasami Kawai, 14 years old! A girl in the second year of junior high school who seems to be everywhere. I'm fine today with my best friend Misao Amano... As Pretty Sammy and Pixie Misa, I was supposed to be a magical girl, but I couldn't transform! Mysterious beasts and new magical girls will come out, and what will happen!??

(Source: Campfire)

title: Aisanai to Iwaremashitemo: Moto Maou no Hakushaku Reijou wa Kimajime Gunjin ni Ezuke wo Sarete Shiawase ni Naru
title_japanese: 愛さないといわれましても ～元魔王の伯爵令嬢は生真面目軍人に餌付けをされて幸せになる～
synopsis:
Unused to humans, Abigail panics when her new husband declares that he'll never love her on the first night of their political marriage. Does that mean she's not allowed to eat?!

A new twist on the food-based romance tale, starring an earl's daughter who was the Monster King in her previous life! After years of neglect by her old family, Abigail will charm her sincere military husband and his household one bite at a time and find her happy ending!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title: Senren＊Banka
synopsis:
Deep in the mountains lies Hoori, a small village so remote that no trains stop there. Due to its isolation, it has resisted the spread of civilization. However, its rustic charm and hot springs have transformed it into a famous tourist destination. One of the village's biggest draws is the divine blade Murasamemaru, stuck in a stone from which no one has been able to pull it out of... until our protagonist Masaomi Arichi manages to break it in half.

Before he can even come to grips with what just happened, he's forced to make amends for what he's done. How, you might ask? By marrying the village's shrine maiden, of course! He's already in way over his head, but this is just the start of his mysterious and unfathomable new life in this village.

Masaomi then goes on to meet his new fiance, discovers an enigmatic and strange girl that only he can touch, and begins to learn about the curse afflicting the village of Hoori. Amidst this hectic new life, who will he set his heart on? The answers he seeks lie within the legendary sword in his hands.

(Source: Neko Nyan, edited)

title: Daikaijuu Gaea-tima
synopsis:
A gigantic monster devastates a small, seaside town. Ten years later, the resilient community has emerged as a tourist destination, when the monster, known as Gaea-tima, returns. Miyako, a local hero and survivor of the first attack, pushes to find a scientific solution to the problem of the giant creatures known as "gigantis." But is humanity capable of responding to violence with anything except more violence?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Shang Shan
synopsis:
A Taoist priest, while tracking a demon, inadvertently discovered that a little girl in a certain family had been raised by the demon. She had consumed demon cores since childhood, altering her constitution, and the demon, due to a heavenly tribulation, could no longer care for her. The priest took the girl as his disciple, giving her the Taoist name Shang Shan, and the two began their journey through the human world, vanquishing demons and exorcising evil spirits.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title: Ookami to Koushinryou: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF 2nd Season
title_japanese: 狼と香辛料 MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF 2期
synopsis: The second season of Ookami to Koushinryou: MERCHANT MEETS THE WISE WOLF.

title: Nabe ni Tama wo Ukenagara
title_english: Getting Shots on a Frying Pan
title_japanese: 鍋に弾丸を受けながら
synopsis:
Meet Juntaro, a Japanese fishing addict who was born and raised in what is perceived to be one of the roughest parts of Japan. It is through his lens where you can experience various parts of the world, their culture, and of course their food. Although her childhood friend Haru accepts and loves her just as she is, Kyuuko still lacks confidence in herself. As she learns to overcome her insecurities, she also helps the humans, foxes, divine messengers, and even gods around her with their own worries.

This heartwarming comedy follows Kyuuko's everyday adventures as she gradually learns to accept herself while bringing smiles to those around her.

As they fight not only for their dreams but for redemption and a shot at a brighter future, they must navigate treacherous challenges that demand both skill and integrity. In this unforgiving world, they are forced to discover what it truly means to rise from the streets—leaving them with one final question: will they find their second chance, or will the rules of survival break them?

synopsis:
Under Morosa's guidance, Luo Feng ventured deeper into the Boundary Beast's lair. In the darkness, his divine power was devoured, and Morosa was hunted for betraying his clan. Luo Feng repelled the encirclement with the Star Tower defense, the Wings of Wu Assassination Blockade, the Golden Claw God for close combat, and the Lie Yuan Technique for suppression. He witnessed the cruel mechanism of the beast devouring evolution—in the end, only a single king would be born. The outer defense lines of the universe were attacked, forcing the humans, crystals, and other races to jointly defend the small universe, while Hong, Thunder God, and Xu Xin stabilized Earth's rear. 

King candidate Bedi appears, stronger and more skilled at manipulating his own kind, mocking Morosa for bowing to "food" and trying to devour it. Luo Feng and Bedi fought head-on, saved Morosa, and promised not to abandon him, causing Luo Feng to shake his devouring instincts for the first time. Bedi commanded the beast horde to launch a final encirclement. Luo Feng changed tactics during extreme exhaustion: Morosa actively distracted the beasts and disrupted Bedi's rhythm. After being severely wounded, Bedi forcibly evolved. Morosa suggested devouring the remnants of his origin himself, and Luo Feng restrained him with the Lieyuan Art and the Bond Mark. Luo Feng suppressed Bedi's origin, and Morosa won the primordial battle in the Storm of Destruction. 

With Bedi's fall and the end of the realm beast calamity, Morosa became the only special realm beast under Luo Feng's command. After the battle, Luo Feng realized that this victory relied on higher civilization legacies such as the Star Tower, Jin World, and Lieyuan Technique. Morosa also sensed that the source of destruction lay far behind. Zuoshanke revealed: All three originate from the Origin Continent, where more complete rules exist, as well as the causality between the Jin and Food Kingdoms. Luo Feng understood that going to the Origin Continent was not about leaving home, but about seeking a true way to protect the human race and the Cosmic Sea. After bidding farewell to Xu Xin, Hong, and Thunder God, he took the Star Tower and Morosa into the Reincarnation Passage, heading to the Origin Continent. 

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The future mortal world has long been refined, filled with evil spirits, and even he, a Heavenly Dao Walker who "fuses all things," is merely a backup food for immortals. 

He gathers a group of outrageous teammates to travel through the future to eliminate evil spirits, with heavenly powers fighting against evil laws, and the bloody battles are packed with absurd laughs. The path to ascension is one where survival is one in ten, hoping to become immortal? Let's get through tonight first.

title: Kkokdu
synopsis:
Jacob, an 11-year-old boy who is looking for kokdu dolls to remember his last moments with his grandmother, accidentally enters the world of these dolls.

The "kokdu", literally "funeral doll", a key element in the work, is a wooden doll that adorned the bier (a carriage that carried a coffin) in the funeral culture of the Joseon Dynasty. It was considered a being that accompanied and protected the deceased, so that they would not feel lonely on their way to the afterlife. These dolls, which appeared in various forms, such as warriors, servants, clowns, and guides, embody the philosophy of Joseon-era Koreans, who viewed death not as something to be feared, but as a warm farewell and a new journey.

(Sources: etoday.co.kr)

From then on, he steps into an endless killing field, leading his team to defy fate and ultimately shatter the heavenly ladder, determined to burn away the cage of destiny with a prairie fire.
